title: A Garden for the Letters
author: Freya Eriksen
blurb: Hazel Voss, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
